title: Detailed motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow-free; no background -->
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='74' r='14' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='74' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#5a5a7a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='74' r='8' fill='#8a8aa8'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='74' r='3' fill='#c0c0e0'/>
  <!-- spokes rear -->
  <line x1='26' y1='60' x2='26' y2='88' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='12' y1='74' x2='40' y2='74' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='16' y1='64' x2='36' y2='84' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='64' x2='16' y2='84' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='74' r='14' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='74' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#5a5a7a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='74' r='8' fill='#8a8aa8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='74' r='3' fill='#c0c0e0'/>
  <!-- spokes front -->
  <line x1='78' y1='60' x2='78' y2='88' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='74' x2='92' y2='74' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='64' x2='88' y2='84' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='88' y1='64' x2='68' y2='84' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- swingarm / frame rear -->
  <rect x='26' y='66' width='30' height='5' rx='2' fill='#9090b0'/>
  <!-- engine block -->
  <rect x='42' y='54' width='20' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e04040'/>
  <rect x='45' y='57' width='14' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ff7070'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <rect x='30' y='60' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c8c8e0'/>
  <rect x='26' y='59' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#a0a0c0'/>
  <!-- fuel tank -->
  <path d='M50 46 Q56 38 66 40 L68 48 Q62 52 52 52 Z' fill='#3090f0'/>
  <path d='M52 46 Q56 41 63 42' fill='none' stroke='#90c8ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M40 42 Q44 36 52 38 L54 44 Q46 46 40 44 Z' fill='#404060'/>
  <path d='M41 41 Q45 37 51 39' fill='none' stroke='#8080a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- frame rail -->
  <rect x='44' y='46' width='26' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9090b0'/>
  <!-- front fork -->
  <line x1='76' y1='60' x2='70' y2='70' stroke='#d0d0e8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='60' x2='82' y2='70' stroke='#a0a0c0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handlebars -->
  <line x1='68' y1='48' x2='82' y2='44' stroke='#e0e0f8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='82' y1='44' x2='86' y2='50' stroke='#e0e0f8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ffe040'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='54' r='5' fill='#fff8c0'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='54' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#ffd040' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='54' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- fuel cap detail -->
  <rect x='58' y='40' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#c8e0ff'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <rect x='36' y='38' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e04040'/>
</svg>
